figs.name: split-range-control-temperature-loop-diagram
figs.alt: split range control temperature loop with TC, two I/P converters, cooling and steam valves
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing one temperature controller output split by two I/P converters, 4 to 12 mA to the cooling valve and 12 to 20 mA to the heating valve.
figs.after_h2: Example: Split Range for Temperature Control Application

figs.name: split-range-control-reactor-heating-cooling-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart of split range control opening steam or cooling valve for a 70 C reactor
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog following the 70 degree reactor example: low temperature drives the output toward 4 mA for steam, high temperature toward 20 mA for cooling.
figs.after_h2: Example: Temperature Control With Heating & Cooling
